title: wagtail-cli configuration
description: JSON Schema for the wagtail-cli dotfiles (.wagtail-cli.toml and ~/.wagtail-cli.toml).

url.title: API base URL
url.description: Base URL of the Wagtail v3 API, for example https://cms.example.com/api/v3/.

token.title: API token
token.description: Wagtail API token, prefixed with `wagtail_`. Prefer environment variables or the user dotfile for real credentials.
